decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for provision of medical services and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for chiropractor purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 8.00am to 6.00pm Mondays to Fridays.

Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.
Condition : 6 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements shown on the approved drawing shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 7 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on the submitted drawing shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.

Condition : 8 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced details of cycle parking provision shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The spaces shall be provided before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 9 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced details of one wheelchair accessible parking space shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The space shall be provided before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 10 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced details of wheelchair accessible toilet facilities shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The facilities shall be provided before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
description: Change of use from Office (B1) to (D1) Chiropractors
